title: Project profile
description: What .idp/profile.json may say (IDE-147, Determinism rules: profile discipline). Every object is closed and every choice is an enum, so a typo such as 'paralel' is an error and never a silent default. Keys that were removed are refused by name in scripts/board.py, with the fix, before this schema is consulted. The hash of the validated profile goes into every claim comment, so a run can be reproduced from the board.

schema_version.description: Which shape of this file the profile was written against. A profile without one is version 0 and is migrated in memory when it is loaded; scripts/board.py carries the migrations.

board.description: Which tracker carries the work. The name resolves to scripts/sync_<board>_state.py.

token_path.description: Where the board's token lives. A path, never the secret.

approvers.description: Who approves at the human gates, first one first (constitution, principle 1). The first is assigned the QA Testing PBI when phase 3 hands the Feature to QA.

protected_branches.description: Branches the runner never pushes to or merges into, on top of main and the repository's default branch, which are always protected (IDE-147: merging into main is never done by the runner). A Feature whose board branch names one is refused before any push.

language.description: The older flat spelling of artifacts.language, still honoured.

kinds.description: What this board calls each of the platform's kinds of work item.

work_item_types.description: Azure DevOps: the older name for kinds.

phases.description: Only a backlog item's states may be renamed. A Feature's phases are the fixed idp: tags.

state_types.description: Azure DevOps: status name to the kind of state it is.

state_map.description: Written only by `states discover` (engineering-catalog): each work item type's todo, doing and done states.

documents_item.description: Azure DevOps: the work item project-level documents are attached to, usually the epic. Azure DevOps has no project documents. Replaces the removed 'epic_id'.

pace_seconds.description: Observation only: seconds to wait after every board write so a human can watch the lifecycle move. Absent or 0 in a normal run.

executors.description: Who fills each role, and how the process is launched (IDE-147, Executors). Each role is an ordered list of agent[:model]; the first available entry wins.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-session deadline for executor-backed model runs. Default: no extra deadline beyond the backend's own waits.

run_as.description: Optional OS user to run model sessions as. When unset, sessions run as the runner's own user.

development.description: Phase 3 finalize (IDE-147, 3.2): how long the witnesses of one PBI may run in all, and the security scanner, when the project has one.

azure_complete_unproven.description: Let the runner complete a PBI's Azure Repos pull request although nothing pins the target branch in that call. Off by default: until experiment 8 shows the service refuses a completion onto a moved target, the runner leaves the pull request open with a comment and a FIX line. When on, the runner's post-merge parent check is what contains the race.

reconcile.description: Whether the runner calls engineering-catalog's ado-board reconcile after each phase. Default true. Set false only for tightly-scoped live runs whose guard forbids any whole-project scan.

run_as.description: Optional OS user to run witnesses, integration build/test, scanners and similar non-model commands as. When unset, they run as the runner's own user.

feature_pr.description: How phase 3 hands a Feature to QA. `auto` opens a real feature pull request when the remote supports one here and blocks otherwise; `branch-only` records that there is no pull request and tells the human to merge the feature branch by hand after QA.

witness_budget_seconds.description: The phase budget for one PBI's witnesses. A plan whose witnesses' worst case does not fit is refused up front. Default 1800.

security_scanner.description: A command run at finalize in the PBI's worktree, with the witnesses' allowlisted environment; a non-zero exit is a defect.

bug_witness.description: How a Bug filed under a Feature gets its witness when its card states none: the regression test the worker must add failing first. `{id}` and `{slug}` are the Bug's id.

test.description: The test file the worker adds; finalize requires it in the diff and failing without the fix.

integration.description: 3.3 Integration (IDE-147): the full build and the full test suite, run on the feature branch with the witnesses' allowlisted environment once every PBI is merged. Without a test command 3.3 blocks the Feature rather than pass it untested.

build.description: The full build. Optional: a project with nothing to build names none. A non-zero exit is a finding, and a fix PBI with this command as its witness.

test.description: The full test suite. A non-zero exit is a finding, and a fix PBI with this command as its witness.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the build and the suite may each run. Past it the Feature is blocked: the command is wrong, not the code. Default 1200.
